name: znetwork_send_packet_unreliable
description: zNetwork::SendPacketUnreliable dispatches to the synchronous or tracked async unreliable DirectPlay send path based on the TCP/IP async-send flag.
known_limits: The smoke uses a fake DirectPlay provider for both dispatch paths; tier S verification is deferred to a zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48c060 validates dispatch on g_zNetwork_TcpIpAsyncSendEnabled, packet-size load from header offset 2, and tail calls to zNetworkDPlay::SendExUnreliableTracked or zNetworkDPlay::SendUnreliable.
The native zNetwork packet-send smoke verifies the synchronous unreliable path, async tracked unreliable path, packet-size forwarding, flags, cancellation behavior, and async handle propagation.
